title: Enforce executor
description: Validate env against the app zod env schema; fail closed on the first invalid key. Validates process.env by default, or a dotenv file when file is set.

schema.description: Schema file path, e.g. {projectRoot}/env.schema.ts. Must export envSchema.

file.description: Optional dotenv file path to validate instead of process.env, e.g. {projectRoot}/dist/router-flux2/dev.env
